he.text: וַיַּעֲבוֹר יְיָ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא׃ יְיָ · יְיָ · אֵל · רַחוּם · וְחַנּוּן · אֶרֶךְ־אַפַּיִם · וְרַב־חֶסֶד · וֶאֱמֶת · נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים · נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע · וְחַטָּאָה · וְנַקֵּה׃ וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנֵנוּ

en.text: “And the Eternal passed by before him (Moses) and proclaimed: The Eternal is the immutable eternal being; an omnipotent God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in beneficence and truth; keeping mercy unto thousands, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin, and acquitting.
